At a glance

Build intuition by making every assumption executable.

PythonModulationSamplingNoise
Collection

The notebooks model quantization, passband sampling, modem behaviour, additive white Gaussian noise, and Bessel-function relationships that appear in angle modulation.

Why it matters

Each derivation becomes an inspectable experiment: parameters can be varied, waveforms plotted, and edge cases compared. The collection became a reusable base for later adaptive-DSP and wireless-network work.

Takeaway

Simulation is not a substitute for theory; it is a way to stress-test intuition and make assumptions executable.
